summary: THE OWNER IS AN ORIGINAL ANIME (T25). Mobile Suit Gundam (1979) credits 原作 = 矢立肇・富野喜幸 — Sunrise's collective pen name plus its own director; Tomino's Asahi Sonorama novels (from 1979-11-30), Nakane Masaaki's novelization, 岡崎優's parallel 冒険王 manga, 近藤和久's 0079 and THE ORIGIN all adapt the anime rather than source it (ja-WP 機動戦士ガンダム, 関連作品). There is therefore NO chapter instrument for a held work to adapt, and all 8 works come back 'no'. Six are plainly original productions: two anniversary promo shorts (ALL THAT GUNDAM 1989, GUNDAM PERFECT MISSION 2009), a model-kit OVA (Gunpla Builders Beginning G — comicalized afterwards, the reverse direction), SD Gundam's first parody shorts, Otomo's CG short Mission to the Rise, and The Impression of First GUNDAM, which is a three-screen DIGEST of the 1979 series and should be re-kinded recap (N8). Cucuruz Doan's Island remakes TV EPISODE 15, not the same-titled MSD manga — Yasuhiko explicitly disclaimed that manga in Gundam Ace. Twilight Axis - Remain of the Red is the only held work with a real novel run behind it (the Twilight AXIS web novel), but that is a DIFFERENT run: decision (d) other_instrument, not a 'yes' here.

works.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island
works.why: Remake of TV EPISODE 15 of the 1979 series (script Yoshihisa Araki), not a manga — ja-WP: 「第15話「ククルス・ドアンの島」のリメイク作品」; wiki infobox adapted from=Cucuruz Doan's Island. Yasuhiko denied adapting the MSD manga (Gundam Ace 12/2021); the 2022 Kadokawa novel novelizes the film.

works.title: 30th GUNDAM PERFECT MISSION
works.why: Original ~3-minute promotional short (PV) for the TV series' 30th anniversary: the franchise's Gundams escort a Core Fighter from Earth to space, set to 哀戦士. ja-WP: 30周年を記念して制作されたプロモーションビデオ(PV). No manga or novel run behind it.

works.title: ALL THAT GUNDAM
works.why: Original ~1-minute 10th-anniversary short: newly drawn footage of every Gundam set to Kenji Kawai's music plus a 夜明けのShooting Star clip cut from 0080, distributed free to buyers of all six 0080 VHS/LD volumes and teasing 0080. No manga or novel.

works.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Twilight Axis - Remain of the Red
works.why: NOT the owner's instrument. Compilation film (赤き残影) of the 6-part 2017 ONA; the ONA's basis is a SEPARATE run — the Twilight AXIS web novel (矢立文庫, 中村浩二郎 / Ark Performance, 全10章・全20回) — and the Gundam Wiki says the anime preceded the novel. Route to decision (d).

works.title: Kidou Senshi SD Gundam
works.why: Original gag shorts — SD Gundam's first animation (3 parts; script Hiroyuki Hoshiyama, dir Osamu Sekita), parodying the ANIME's own One Year War beats. ja-WP: SD Gundam spread through ガシャポン / BB戦士 / カードダス / toys, not a manga. No run adapted.

works.title: Mokei Senshi Gunpla Builders Beginning G
works.why: Original 3-part model-kit OVA for Gunpla's 30th anniversary (2010; 黒田洋介 / 松尾衡). The comic runs the OTHER way — ja-WP: 「アニメ版の内容を元にストーリーを膨らませたコミカライズ版が『ケロケロエース』で連載された」 (plus 漫画 ガンプラビルダーズA, 角川 2010-2011). No source run.

works.title: Gundam: Mission To The Rise
works.why: Original ~3-minute full-CG short by Katsuhiro Otomo, screened 1998-08-01 at the ガンダムビッグバン宣言 20th-anniversary event. ja-WP: オリジナル短編CG映像作品 set in 従来のシリーズとは設定の異なる大友克洋監督によるオリジナル世界. No manga or novel run.

works.title: The Impression of First GUNDAM
works.why: A RECAP, not an adaptation — a multi-screen digest of the 1979 anime screened at the same 1998-08-01 ガンダムビッグバン宣言 event. Eyewitness report: 「ファースト ガンダム・マルチビジョン ダイジェスト」, three 280-inch screens, partly re-recorded 6ch audio, some 劇場版 footage. Re-kind to recap.

flags_for_sean: OWNER (T25): mobile-suit-gundam is an ORIGINAL Sunrise/Tomino anime — 原作 矢立肇・富野喜幸, no manga or novel source; Tomino's Asahi Sonorama novels (1979-11-30 →), 岡崎優's 冒険王 manga, 近藤和久's 0079 and THE ORIGIN all adapt the anime. No held work CAN adapt 'the owner's instrument' because there is none; every entry says what the work actually derives from instead.

SEMANTICS: I read adapts_chapters as the protocol defines it (the OWNER's chapters), so all 8 are 'no'. On the broad reading of the ask ('a manga or novel run AT ALL') exactly one flips: 104557 Twilight Axis - Remain of the Red, whose ONA rests on the Twilight AXIS web novel (矢立文庫, 全10章・全20回, 2016-11-07 – 2017-12-28; also a 3-vol 月刊ヤングマガジン manga 2017-2019). One-line edit if the broad reading was meant — but the protocol routes a different run to decision (d) other_instrument, not to the per-work programme.

KIND REPAIR (19977 The Impression of First GUNDAM): stored kind 'special' → 'recap'. It is a re-edit of the 1979 series' own footage (incl. 劇場版 cuts) across three 280-inch screens with a partly re-recorded 6ch mix — N8 recap, nothing new in the source line. Evidence tier: ja-WP names it as co-screened at the event; the contemporaneous eyewitness after-report (gundamania.com, Shift-JIS, quoted in the note) is what describes the content. No official page survives; AniDB/AniList's 'selected scenes re-edited for three giant projections' is the same lineage as the context, cross-check only.

TITLE / DATE to check at curation: 104557 is stored as 'Remain of the Red'; the Gundam Wiki and the official site render 赤き残影 as 'Red Trace' (same work — the compilation film of the 6-part ONA) and date it 2017-11-17 vs AniList's 2017-11-18. AniList's 1989-01-01 (ALL THAT GUNDAM) and 2009-01-01 (PERFECT MISSION) are year-only placeholders — All That Gundam was a buy-all-six bonus for 0080, which ran 1989-03-25 to 1989-08-25, so January cannot be right. 2302 has a date fork not researched further: ANN/AniList/Gundam Wiki 1988-03-12, ja-WP 1988年5月25日 (逆襲のシャア併映, advance screening of parts 1-2).

OUTSIDE THE ASK (position, for the per-work pass): 139273 Cucuruz Doan's Island remakes episode 15 and is set between Jaburo and Odessa, i.e. mid-run; the stored position is @43.62, after the 43-episode run. Worth reconsidering when the film is ruled.
